    Linear functors out of Hom-ideal quotients #

    An additive linear functor which kills a two-sided Hom ideal factors through the corresponding categorical quotient. Fullness descends to the quotient, while the reverse inclusion from the functor kernel into the Hom ideal makes the descended functor faithful.
